parts.passageHtml:
{[Ecotourism is often regarded as a form of nature-based tourism and has become an important alternative source of tourists.][106940]} {[In addition to providing the traditional resort-leisure product, it has been argued that ecotourism resort management should have a particular focus on best-practice environmental management, an educational and interpretive component, and direct and indirect contributions to the conservation of the natural and cultural environment (Ayala.][106959]} {[I996).][107005]} {[Couran Cove Island Resort is a large integrated ecotourism-based resort located south of Brisbane on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia.][107008]} {[As the world’s population becomes increasingly urbanised, the demand for tourist attractions which are environmentally friendly, serene and offer amenities of a unique nature has grown rapidly.][107028]} {[Couran Cove Resort, which is one such tourist attractions, is located on South Stradbroke Island, occupying approximately 150 hectares of the island.][107055]} {[South Stradbroke Island is separated from the mainland by the Broadwater, a stretch of sea several kilometres wide.][107078]} {[More than a century ago, there was only one Stradbroke Island, and there were at least four Aboriginal tribes living and limiting on the island.][107096]} {[Regrettably, most of the original island dwellers were eventually killed by diseases such as tuberculosis, smallpox and influenza by the end of the 19th century.][107121]} {[The second ship wrecked on the island in 1894, and the subsequent destruction of the ship (the Cambus Wallace) because it contained dynamite, caused a large crater in the sandhills on Stradbroke Island.][107147]} {[Eventually, the ocean broke through the weakened land form and Stradbroke became two islands.][107179]} {[Conran Cove Island Resort is built on one of the world’s new naturally -occurring sand lands, which is home to a wide range of plant communities and one of the largest remaining remnants of the rare livistona rainforest left on the Gold Coast.][107194]} {[Many mangrove and rainforest areas, and Malaleuca Wetlands on South Stradbroke Island (and in Queensland), have been cleared, drained or filled for residential, industrial, agricultural or urban development in the first half of the 20th century.][107239]} {[Farmers and graziers finally abandoned South Stradbroke Island in 1959 because the vegetation and the soil conditions there were not suitable for agricultural activities.][107276]} {[SUSTAINABLE PRACTICES OF COUKAN COVE RESORT][107301]}

{[Being located on an offshore island, the resort is only accessible by means of water transport.][107309]} {[The resort provides hourly ferry service from the marina on the mainland to and from the island.][107326]} {[Within the resort, transport modes include walking trails, bicycle tracks and the beach train.][107344]} {[The reception area is the counter of the shop which has not changed for 8 years at least.][107359]} {[The accommodation is an octagonal “Bure’’.][107378]} {[These are large rooms that are clean but the equipment is tilted and in some cases just working.][107384]} {[Our ceiling fan only worked at high speed, for example.][107403]} {[Beds are hard but clean.][107414]} {[There is a television, a radio, an old air conditioner and a small fridge.][107420]} {[These “Bures” are right on top of each other and night noises do carry, so be careful what you say and do.][107431]} {[The only tilting is the mosquitoes, but if you forget to bring mosquito repellant, they sell some oil on the island.][107454]} {[As an ecotourism-based resort, most of the planning and development of the attraction has been concentrated on the need to co-exist with the fragile natural environment of South Stradbroke Island to achieve sustainable development.][107476]} {[WATER AND ENERGY MANAGEMENT][107510]}

{[South Stradbroke Island has groundwater at the centre of the island, which has a maximum height of 3 metres above sea level.][107516]} {[The water supply is recharged by rainfall and is commonly known as an unconfined freshwater aquifer.][107538]} {[Couran Cove Island Resort obtains its water supply by tapping into this aquifer and extracting it via a bore system.][107554]} {[Some of the problems which have threatened the island’s freshwater supply include pollution, contamination and over-consumption.][107574]} {[In order to minimise some of these problems, all laundry activities are carried out on the mainland.][107591]} {[The resort considers washing machines as onerous to the island’s freshwater supply, and that the detergents contain a high level of phosphates which are a major source of water pollution.][107609]} {[The resort uses LPG-power generation rather than a diesel-powered plant for its energy supply, supplemented by wind turbine, which has reduced greenhouse emissions by 70% of diesel-equivalent generation methods.][107638]} {[Excess heat recovered from the generator is used to heat the swimming pool.][107667]} {[Hot water in the eco-cabins and for some of the resort’s vehicles are solar-powered.][107681]} {[Water efficient fittings are also installed in showers and toilets.][107696]} {[However, not all the appliances used by the resort are energy efficient, such as refrigera­tors.][107707]} {[Visitors who stay at the resort are encouraged to monitor their water and energy usage via the in-house television systems, and are rewarded with prizes (such as a free return trip to the resort) accordingly if their usage level is low.][107723]} {[CONCLUDING REMARKS][107764]}

{[We examined a case study of good management practice and a pro-active sustainable tourism stance of an eco-resort.][107768]} {[In three years of operation, Couran Cove Island Resort has won 23 international and national awards, including the 2001 Australian Tourism Award in the 4-Star Accommodation category.][107785]} {[The resort has embraced and has effectively implemented contem­porary environmental management practices.][107813]} {[It has been argued that the successful implemen­tation of the principles of sustainability should promote long-term social, economic and envi­ronmental benefits, while ensuring and enhancing the prospects of continued viability for the tourism enterprise.][107826]} {[Couran Cove Island Resort does not conform to the characteristics of the Resort Development Spectrum, as proposed by Pridcaux (2000).][107861]} {[According to Pridcaux.][107882]} {[the resort should be at least at Phase 3 of the model (the National tourism phase), which describes an integrated resort providing 3-4 star hotel-type accommodation.][107886]} {[The primary tourist market in Phase 3 of the model consists mainly of interstate visitors.][107915]} {[However, the number of interstate and international tourists visiting the resort is small, with the principal visitor markets com­prising locals and residents from nearby towns and the Gold Coast region.][107931]} {[The carrying capac­ity of Couran Cove does not seem to be of any concern to the Resort management.][107962]} {[Given that it is a private commercial ecotourist enterprise, regulating the number of visitors to the resort to minimise damage done to the natural environment on South Stradbroke Island is not a binding constraint.][107981]} {[However, the Resort’s growth will eventually be constrained by its carrying capac­ity, and quantity control should be incorporated in the management strategy of the resort.][108014]}

questionSets.instructionHtml:
Questions 1 - 5:

Choose the correct letter A, B, C or D.
Write the correct letter in boxes 1-5 on your answer sheet.

options.text: by an intended destruction of the ship of the Cambus Wallace.
by an explosion of dynamite on a ship and following nature erosion.
by the movement of sandhills on Stradbroke Island.
by the volcanic eruption on island.

questions.explanationHtml:
B
 
crater (n) khoảng trống lớn (thường được tạo ra do bom, thuốc nổ)
Đảo Stradbroke bị tách ra làm 2 đảo do có 1 con thuyền (Cambus Wallace) mang thuốc nổ - "dynamite" bị đắm "wrecked" vào năm 1894 tạo ra 1 lỗ hổng lớn. Dần dần, nước biển tràn vào và chia cắt làm 2 đảo.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Câu A là not given vì không biết thuyền Cambus Wallace có phải là "intended" - có dự định sẵn sẽ đâm vào đảo và gây nổ hay không (xác suất cao là không)
Câu C là sai vì các "sandhills" không có di chuyển
Câu D là not given vì không đề cập đến nủi lửa phun trào - "volcanic eruption"

options.text: to obtain its water supply via a bore system
to preserve the water and anti-pollution
to save the cost of installing onerous washing machines
to reduce the level of phosphates in water around

questions.explanationHtml:
B
 
preserve (v) bảo tồn, giữ gìn
laundry activities: hoạt động giặt giũ
Couran Cove Island Resort có nguồi nước ngầm nhưng "recharge" - nạp lại, cung cấp nước cho nguồn nước này từ nước mưa - "rainfall" nên các vấn đề thường gặp là "pollution" - ô nhiễm và "over-consumption" - tiêu thụ quá mức. Chính vì vậy, các hoạt động giặt giũ phải được thực hiện ở "mainland" - đất liền để tiết kiệm nước và chống ô nhiễm

options.text: desalining the sea water.
collecting the rainfall.
transporting from the mainland.
boring ground water.

questions.explanationHtml:
D
 
boring system: hệ thống khoan lỗ và ống dẫn
ground water: nước ngầm
Couran Cove Island Resort có nguồi nước ngầm nhưng "recharge" - nạp lại, cung cấp nước cho nguồn nước này từ nước mưa - "rainfall" nên nguồn chính vẫn là nước ngầm nhé. Các bạn rất dễ SAI nếu không đọc kĩ bài và chọn câu B. Dân trên đảo KHÔNG CÓ hứng nước mưa để xài, nước mưa sẽ thấm vào đất và làm đầy mạch nước ngầm, và họ sẽ xài mạch nước ngầm đó.

options.text: the LPG-power
a diesel-powered plant
the wind power
the solar-power

questions.explanationHtml:
D
Keyword là "heating water" - làm nóng nước. Trên đảo, họ dùng năng lượng từ LPG-power generation thay vì "diesel-powered plant" - nhà máy nhiệt điện chạy bằng dấu diesel, và họ dùng "solar power" - năng lượng mặt trời để làm nóng nước trong cabin

options.text: more awards for resort’s accommodation
sustainable administration and development in a long run
economic and environmental benefits for the tourism enterprise
successful implementation of the Resort Development Spectrum

questions.explanationHtml:
B
 
sustainable (a) bền vững
concentrate = focus on: tập trung vào cái gì đó
Những kế hoạch phát triển của resort luôn tập trung vào nhu cầu "co-exist" - sống cùng với thiên nhiên quá mỏng manh, yếu kém của đảo để đạt được phát triển bền vững

questionSets.contentHtml: Being located away from the mainland, tourists can attain the resort only by 6  in a regular service provided by the resort itself. Within the resort, transports include trails for walking or tracks for both 7  and the beach train. The on-island equipment is old-fashioned which is barely working such as the 8  overhead. There is television, radio, an old 9  and a small fridge. And you can buy the repellent for 10   if you forget to bring some.
